title: The hypernear contract can verify a real Intel TDX (dstack/Phala) attestation on-chain, and at what cost

refs.method: tee_verify_spike (feature tee): shade-attestation DstackAttestation::verify with only the fixture's own measurements and PPID accepted
refs.build: cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm [--features tee] (cargo-near 0.23.0, rustc 1.99.1, clang 14) in a rust:1.99-bookworm container: ring needs clang for wasm32, ci32 has none
refs.fixture: near/mpc crates/test-utils/assets/public_data.json @ 50328c652770c1f97609c25749b46c48ace592d6 (real dstack TDX quote, collateral, tcb_info); contract/tests/tee/attestation.json
refs.crate: shade-attestation 0.2.0 vendored from NearDeFi/shade-agent-framework @ 3366bc988e19d66c31397a7669099f59091d2560 (src unmodified, pins relaxed; dcap-qvl =0.5.2)

notes: Verified on-chain: the call returned the fixture's measurements and PPID.
Cargo tests (native): the recorded quote passes; a tampered quote, wrong RTMR2 / compose hash, wrong report_data, wrong PPID and a timestamp before issuance all fail.

Timestamp: the collateral has validity windows. The recorded fixture verifies only at its fixed time 1786622400; at 2026-11-08 it fails with DcapVerification("TCBInfo expired"). T1 must pass the block time and take fresh collateral with each registration.
Gas 187 TGas of the 300 TGas per-call limit and 764 KB of wasm: under the gate (300 TGas) and under the 1.5 MB threshold, so verification goes in the main contract; no separate verifier was measured.
Dependency: crates.io shade-attestation 0.2.0 pins serde_with =3.17.0, near-sdk 5.30 needs ^3.20, hence the vendored copy under contract/vendor/shade-attestation.
